name: DENC7SNOMEDConceptMap
title: DEN.C7 ConceptMap to SNOMED CT
description: Candidate mappings from DEN.C7 local concepts to SNOMED CT supplied by the data dictionary. They are not validated equivalences.

text.div:
Candidate SNOMED CT codes are transcribed from the workbook. Numeric Excel values are normalized to SCTID strings. The relatedto relationship avoids claiming equivalence; each candidate needs independent terminology review. The care-level targets are environment concepts and may not represent management decisions.

  • starts-hydration: The source target describes rehydration therapy, while the local concept is a question about whether hydration was initiated; this is a candidate relation only.
  • oral-hydration: Candidate code copied from the source worksheet and normalized from its numeric Excel value; validate against SNOMED CT.
  • iv-hydration: Candidate code copied from the source worksheet and normalized from its numeric Excel value; validate against SNOMED CT.
  • no-hydration: The source combines not indicated and not yet initiated; the candidate qualifier does not distinguish these meanings and needs review.
  • define-management: The source workbook supplies no SNOMED CT code for this question concept.
  • ambulatory-care: The target describes an environment/site and may not represent the management decision; candidate relation needs review.
  • in-hospital-care: The source says closer monitoring without full admission; the candidate is an environment concept and may not represent that care level.
  • hospital-care: The target display is primary care hospital environment, which may conflict with the source hospital-care definition; candidate relation needs review.
  • intensive-care-icu: The target identifies a care environment, not necessarily the management decision itself; candidate relation needs review.
